tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Antibacterial spectrum of rLJ-hep2 (recombinant protein) and LJ-hep2(66–86) (chemically synthesized peptide).
footnotes: a CGMCC No., China General Microbiological Culture Collection Number. b The MIC and MBC values are presented as the interval (A), (B): (A) is the highest concentration tested with visible microbial growth, while (B) is the lowest concentration without visible microbial growth (n = 3). c Bacteria isolated from diseased fish, provided by Freshwater Fisheries Research Institute of Fujian.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Anti-drug resistant bacterial activities of chemically synthesized LJ-hep2(66–86).
footnotes: a The MIC and MBC values are presented as the interval (A), (B): (A) is the highest concentration tested with visible microbial growth, while (B) is the lowest concentration without visible microbial growth (n = 3).

db_assertions.db_subject: The Antimicrobial Peptide LJ-hep2 from Lateolabrax japonicus Exerting Activities against Multiple Pathogenic Bacteria and Immune Protection In Vivo
db_assertions.db_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (86.36%) to hepcidin TH1-5 C: 38%. Activity: active against Gram- S. flexneri (MIC 3-6 uM), P. fluorescens (MIC 6-12 uM), P. stutzeri (MIC 1.5-3 um), E. coli QZ18109 or QZ18110 (MIC 3-12 uM), P. aeruginosa QZ19124 or QZ19125 (MIC 6-12 uM), A. baumannii QZ18050A or QZ18055 (MIC 1.5-3 uM), K. pneumoniae QZ18106 or QZ18107 (MIC 6-24 uM), A. hydrophila (MIC 24-48 uM), E. tarda (MIC 24-48 uM), A. sobria (MIC 24-48 uM), Gram+ S. epidermidis (MIC 6-12 uM), C. glutamicum (MIC 3-6 uM), B. subtilis (MIC 6-12 uM), E. faecium QZ18080 (MIC 6-12 uM) and fungi C. neoformans (MIC 12-24 uM). Recombinant production:yeast:Pichia pastoris: recombinant peptide rLJ-hep2 and syntehtic form were obtained for additional stuides ( Gong et al., 2022). Update 7/2025
